description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Master of the Veil trigger, turning it face-down
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.name: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods
